{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Commitment to vigorously implement, enforce, and build on President Obama's Dodd-Frank financial reform law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to stop Republican efforts to weaken the Dodd-Frank financial reform law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to stop Republican efforts to hamstring regulators through budget cuts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to ensure regulators have the resources and independence to fully enforce the law and hold both individuals and corporations accountable when they break the rules.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to continue to protect consumers and defend the CFPB from Republican attacks.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to any efforts to change the CFPB's structure from a single director to a partisan, gridlocked Commission.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to any efforts to remove the CFPB's independent funding and subject it to the appropriations process.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to continue to support the CFPB in enforcing foundational civil rights laws protecting against discrimination in consumer lending.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Condemnation of predatory payday lending.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to protect consumers by defending the CFPB and implementing strong new regulations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for a financial transactions tax on Wall Street to curb excessive speculation and high-frequency trading.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Goal to create a financial system and an economy that works for all Americans, not just a handful of billionaires.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
